review: Similar to Liu Ishmael, Liu Rodion is a DPS ID who benefits from Burn stacking. She has very high rolling numbers on Skills, although this comes with a requirement of having Burn stacks, which is relatively easy to do in a Burn focused team. Furthermore, due to how Burn works, she can maintain these numbers easily, although she will need some time to ramp up Burn stacks initially. Outside of Burn teams, she is quite weak.
